title: Backend Engineer (all genders)
fullText:
JustPlay is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build, improve, and scale the services that keep our platform secure.

In this role, you’ll focus on our Fraud domain, developing reliable backend solutions, improving infrastructure, and supporting fraud prevention efforts. You'll work closely with engineers, Fraud analysts, and other stakeholders to tackle technical challenges and make a direct impact on the security and reliability of our platform.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services supporting JustPlay's fraud detection and prevention efforts

  • Build and improve the infrastructure behind our Fraud service, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance

  • Collaborate closely with Fraud analysts to investigate incidents, implement solutions, and strengthen fraud prevention measures

  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment efficiency and reliability

  • Work with engineers and stakeholders to plan, prioritize, and deliver technical improvements

  • Share knowledge and contribute to a more resilient, maintainable Fraud service, reducing dependencies and strengthening team ownership

Job Requirements:

  • You have hands-on experience with Kotlin or another JVM-based programming language (e.g. Java)

  • You have solid experience working with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP

  • You are familiar with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL

  • You are skilled in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Workflows

  • You actively use AI coding agents and LLMs in your daily development workflow

  • You have experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform

  • You have strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, collaborative mindset


Job Benefits:

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Munich Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free lunch on a daily basis, and dog-friendly environment

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. title: Growth Strategist – Rewarded, CTV & New Channels (all genders)
fullText:
JustPlay is looking for a Growth Strategist to drive the next phase of our User Acquisition growth across Rewarded, Connected TV (CTV) and emerging channels. Beyond campaign management, you’ll define the long-term strategy, identify new growth opportunities and turn them into measurable results.

You’ll decide where JustPlay should grow next, why, and how we’ll know it’s working. Then you’ll build it end to end: strategy, partners, budget, measurement and scale. Day-to-day execution is part of the job. Your real impact is defining what our growth looks like a year from now.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own the long-term growth strategy for Rewarded, CTV and new channels, setting priorities, identifying opportunities and driving measurable results.

  • Lead and scale the Rewarded channel, owning strategy, partnerships, payout models (playtime, multi-reward, CPE) and budgets, while keeping ROAS, retention and fraud in check.

  • Build and scale CTV as a performance channel, owning strategy, partners, audiences, creative direction and incrementality measurement (geo-lift and holdout testing).

  • Identify, test and scale new acquisition channels, evaluating opportunities and turning successful experiments into sustainable growth streams.

  • Own a structured testing roadmap across channels and platforms, with clear hypotheses, success criteria, sample sizes and decision rules for every test.

  • Own channel measurement and attribution, partnering with Data to develop dashboards, incrementality frameworks and performance reporting.

  • Manage strategic partner relationships, negotiating commercial terms and ensuring performance and accountability.

  • Work across functions with Product, Creative, Data and Engineering on UA × Product experiments, creative for TV and rewarded formats, and the tracking these channels need.

  • Act as a strategic partner to UA lead and the team, challenging assumptions, mentoring team members and shaping future growth opportunities.

Job Requirements

  • You have 5+ years of experience in mobile User Acquisition within gaming or mobile apps, including at least 2 years owning budgets and channel performance at scale.

  • You think beyond campaigns, with proven experience defining channel strategies, gaining leadership buy-in and owning results.

  • You have hands-on experience with rewarded and incentivized UA (playtime, offerwall, multi-reward or CPE), including payout models, partner management and fraud control.

  • You have a track record of launching new channels from scratch, from assessing opportunities and testing to scaling or stopping based on results.

  • You have strong analytical skills in cohort and LTV/ROAS analysis, attribution (MMP, SKAN, probabilistic vs. deterministic) and experiment statistics. SQL is a strong plus.

  • You are proficient with Adjust, Firebase and Looker (or similar BI tools), as well as Jira, Miro and Figma.

  • You actively use AI tools such as Claude to improve analysis, experimentation and decision-making.

title: Retention & CLV Operator (all genders)
fullText:
Welcome to Glow25!

At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on.

We look forward to getting to know you.

These are our current challenges and future goals:

Five years ago, Glow25 started from zero. Today we are one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands, with a large community of returning customers. Our biggest lever is making sure those customers stay with us: through a strong subscription programme, a loyalty programme and a lifecycle experience that gives them a reason to come back, again and again.

To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Retention & CLV Operator who works alongside our existing teams, keeps the big picture in view and sets up our retention engine structurally. Ownership covers Klaviyo flows, our subscription programme and our loyalty programme, plus post-purchase, replenishment, education, win-back and sales campaigns. Copy, flows and launches come from one person, with access to a rich customer data set and the freedom to build individual AI workflows. Lifecycle work that was written and built personally, and that moved repeat purchase or customer value, makes an application stand out.

This role joins an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving them together with the teams is encouraged.

This is where we need your support:

  • Retention strategy and customer journey: Strategic thinking that keeps the whole lifecycle in view and sets up retention structurally, from onboarding, product education and replenishment to cross-sell and win-back, so that customers stay with us long term and the setup scales across markets.

  • Subscription and loyalty programmes: Experience building and growing a subscription offering and loyalty mechanics, from the sign-up experience and churn prevention to VIP experiences that turn customers into long-term fans.

  • Lifecycle flows in Klaviyo: Hands-on expertise in building triggers, audiences, timing, branches and suppression rules independently in Klaviyo.

  • Copy and campaigns: Direct-response copywriting and storytelling that moves customers, from campaign emails to long-form sales sequences, plus planning and running customer moments, product launches and seasonal sales together with Acquisition and Creative.

  • Data and AI-driven decisions: Confidence in using cohort, repeat-purchase and contribution-margin evidence to choose tests and make clear decisions, paired with practical use of AI for customer research, copy exploration and workflows, with human judgment on claims and final copy.

  • Localization and collaboration: A feel for adapting stories and offers to each market instead of translating them, while keeping one brand voice, and a collaborative way of working with Acquisition, Customer Service, Product and Analytics, sharing learnings so that all teams get faster.

You have the following experience:

  • Personally written and built lifecycle programs in D2C or e-commerce, ideally in a high-repeat category such as supplements, beauty or food, with clear proof of what was written, built, launched, measured and changed.

  • Track record of subscription, loyalty, post-purchase, replenishment or win-back programs that moved repeat purchase, revenue per recipient or customer value.

  • Strong direct-response instincts and storytelling skills across short and long formats, plus hands-on experience in a lifecycle platform, ideally Klaviyo.

  • A structural, big-picture mindset and comfort with e-commerce economics and experiments: retention set up as a system rather than a series of one-off campaigns, with the ability to separate real lift from attributed revenue, without being a pure analyst.

  • Hands-on use of AI in the last 12 months to speed up research, copy or workflows. Show us what you built.

  • A collaborative communicator who brings colleagues along by explaining decisions clearly and sharing learnings, fluent in English; German or another European language is a plus.

That's something you can look forward to:

  • Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.

  • Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.

  • Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.

  • Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.

  • Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.

  • Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

  • Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

  • Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.

  • Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.

  • Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

  • Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.

  • Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

Yay! You've made it this far!

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: Founding Account Executive – Poland
fullText:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Poland for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Poland is one of our expansion markets. It has become one of Europe’s major manufacturing hubs, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Poland from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Poland.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Poland from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Poland end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Polish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English. Polish is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

fullText:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen.

Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern Lösungen selbst bauen?

Bei Omniwatt bauen wir konsequent neue Geschäftsbereiche aus und entwickeln bestehende Bereiche weiter. In dieser Rolle baust du neue Prozesse, automatisierst bestehende und verantwortest deine Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live, von der konzeptionellen Strategie bis zur operativen Ausführung. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Operations und Tech und siehst direkt, was deine Lösungen bewirken.

  • Du analysierst unsere Prozesse bis ins Detail, erkennst die größten Hebel und baust Lösungen, die im Alltag wirklich funktionieren.

  • Du entwickelst KI-Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit Low-Code- und No-Code-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb.

  • Du denkst Kundenkommunikation neu, testest neue Ansätze in kleinen Schritten und machst ihren Erfolg mit Daten messbar.

  • Du bringst Customer Support, Operations und Tech zusammen und treibst Themen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst erste Berufserfahrung oder relevante Praktika mit, z. B. aus einem Startup, Scale-up, der Beratung oder dem Venture Building.

  • KI-Tools wie Claude gehören für dich ganz selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag. In Low-Code- und No-Code-Tools wie Airtable oder Make sowie SQL hast du Erfahrung oder arbeitest dich gern ein.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und bringst Ideen zügig in die Umsetzung, auch wenn der Weg noch nicht vorgezeichnet ist.

title: Senior People Operations Engineer
fullText:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

The Team and Your Impact

Hi, I'm Gio, and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027.

Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch.

You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you.

What you will own

About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. Your first year has four main areas:

  • AI-native People Ops

    • Use Claude and MCP frameworks every day to build agents and automations that take repetitive work off the team, starting with request triage and policy questions

    • Get the process and documentation right before you automate it, and decide what should stay human

    • Share what you learn, so the rest of the team picks up the same tools

  • People platforms, data, and analytics

    • Own our HRIS and people stack, including integrations, access, and data quality

    • Build people analytics and reporting, and work with me to turn the data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition and engagement trends to headcount planning

  • Global employment and payroll

    • Lead our move to a single global payroll provider, replacing today’s mix of US PEO, EOR, and local payroll setups with one platform, and make sure employment contracts, visas, and Finance coordination carry through the transition without gaps.

    • Design onboarding, mobility, and offboarding so they work the same way in every country

    • Be the go-to person for tricky cases like relocations, with external counsel behind you

  • Policies and benefits

    • Own our employee policies end to end, from drafting and legal review with counsel to rollout and upkeep

    • Design and launch a global benefits offering, country by country

    • Build a self-service documentation library, so people can find answers without asking

Who you are

  • You've spent 5 or more years in People Ops, HR operations, or People Systems, including time in a scaling, remote-first People function with EU and US presence

  • You've employed people in several countries across entities, EOR, and freelancers, with hands-on US and EU experience, and you know how to keep it compliant

  • You've worked with EOR, PEO, and global payroll platforms and can spot what looks off in payroll inputs before it goes out

  • You've owned an HRIS and people stack hands on, from setup to integrations and data quality, and you have real people analytics experience

  • You have strong Claude and Claude Code skills and use AI and MCP daily. You've built agents, skills, automations, or integrations that took real work off a team, ideally on HR or business systems. You know how to use AI with people data safely and in line with GDPR

  • You know your way around HR and automation tools: ideally Ashby and Leapsome (or HiBob, Greenhouse, or Personio), Deel or Remote, Jira, and n8n, Zapier, or Make

Nice to have

  • Comfort with APIs, webhooks, or light scripting

  • Knowledge of German or Spanish employment law, and a working grasp of US labor and employment rules

  • You have built a benefits offering across countries or consolidated EOR and payroll vendors

This role is probably not for you if you:

  • Need to be told what to fix first, or wait for a playbook before deciding

  • Want the process designed before you run it

  • Would rather someone else figure out the solution, and just implement it

  • Struggle with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and adapting as the market evolves, so priorities will shift

  • Prefer a quick call to writing things down, since we work async first

Interview process

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
fullText:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.

title: GTM Engineer (f/m/d)
fullText:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

bunch is growing its sales team in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Each account executive owns a set of named accounts and reaches out when something happens at one of them, for example a new fundraise or a new CFO. You build and run the system that supports this: the data on our market of fund managers, the signals that tell an account executive when to reach out, and the preparation of outreach.

You will:

  • Prepare a book of accounts for every new Account Executive, with the right contacts and the CRM history.

  • Keep the fund managers in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany up to date in HubSpot.

  • Create HubSpot tasks from signals such as fundraises, regulator registrations (FCA, BaFin, CSSF), new hires in finance and operations, and contacts who change firm.

  • Set up a weekly account brief for each account executive and drafted messages that improve from account executive feedback.

  • Show account executives who at bunch already knows someone at an account to increase a partnership revenue channel.

  • Get recorded calls into HubSpot, and add stage rules and required fields that keep the CRM data clean.

  • Route inbound leads to the account executive who owns the account.

  • Build all of this as code that is scheduled, monitored and documented.

About you

  • 3+ years building a GTM or revenue operations system end to end at a B2B company.

  • You understand how B2B sales teams work and like to work closely with account executives.

  • Deep HubSpot knowledge: custom objects, associations, workflows, the API, and where HubSpot breaks.

  • Daily use of Claude or similar AI tools, and a clear view of where they fail and where they can be put to use for account executives.

  • Knowledge of the modern data stack (ingestion, warehouse, transformation, reverse ETL, enrichment) and how it connects to the CRM.

  • You know which leading indicators to track, why they predict revenue, and how to make them reliable in the CRM.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Hybrid work

  • 28 days of paid vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays.

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

title: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
fullText:
3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote

  • Level: Senior to lead

  • Location: Remote, CET overlap

  • Contract: Full time, long term

About us

We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft.

The project

Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same.

Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this.

About the role

We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer.

You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them.

The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team.

You report to the Art Director.

What you will do

Environment art

  • Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit.

  • Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts.

  • Build modular kits that can be reused across levels.

  • Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction.

Level design

  • Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared.

  • Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine.

  • Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results.

  • Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression.

  • Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines.

What we are looking for

  • Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development.

  • Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish.

  • Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts.

  • A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final.

  • Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity.

  • Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it.

  • Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials.

  • Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning.

  • Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team.

  • Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect.

Nice to have

  • 3D character or gameplay animation.

  • 3D character modelling.

  • Technical art or VFX.

  • Experience with GitHub or Fork.

  • Experience with player-built levels, or tools for game creators.

  • Experience in a small team where you covered more than one role.

What we offer

  • A fully remote team with flexible working.

  • Trust to manage your own time. We do not use timesheets.

  • Ownership of the game’s spaces, from first layout to final.

  • A small team where people help each other.

Working setup

  • Fully remote. Your working day needs to overlap with CET.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract. It is business to business.

  • We would like you to start as soon as you are available.

What this role is not

  • Not a lead game designer role. Our Creative Director sets the direction of the game.

  • Not an art-only or design-only role. You will do both.

How to apply

Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. If we shortlist you, the next step is interviews, and for final candidates an unpaid planning task of about two hours at an agreed time, with no modelling or texturing. We reply to everyone at every step.

Disclosure

This application will be evaluated with the help of an AI tool that checks your CV and application against the criteria for this role. A human recruiter always makes the final decision. The AI does not reject or accept anyone on its own. If your application isn’t taken forward, you can ask us for an explanation of how the AI was used in that decision. title: Lead Instructor, EMEA
fullText:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About TRM

TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day.

TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations.

About the Role

As the Lead Instructor, EMEA, you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. Cyber and OSINT tradecraft is the complement: you will show investigators how to pair it with on-chain tracing to build a complete case.

EMEA is a region where we win by showing up. You will deliver in person, in the room, with customers across the UK, DACH, the Nordics and Baltics, France, and beyond, and you will work closely with our regional sales, value engineering, and customer success teams so that training drives adoption and opens the next conversation. You will join a Training Team of master instructors who can command a room, build engaging content, and speak to every level of expertise. We know how our products are used in the real world and help our customers become humble masters too.

This is also a build role. EMEA training is a growing opportunity, and you will help shape how it is scoped, packaged, and delivered as the region scales.

Please note: this role requires travel of 50-75%, primarily across EMEA.

The Impact You'll Have Here

  • Program manage and deliver live, in-person, and virtual blockchain intelligence training to law enforcement, national security, and government learners across EMEA.

  • Teach crypto fundamentals through advanced investigations on TRM's blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms, helping investigators trace funds and build complete, defensible cases.

  • Develop and maintain curriculum, labs, and practical exercises that stay current with the crypto threat landscape, including fraud, scams, ransomware, hacks and exploits, terrorism finance, sanctions evasion, and money laundering typologies.

  • Adapt content for regional legal frameworks, case types, and audience maturity, from first-time crypto investigators to experienced national security analysts.

  • Pair on-chain tracing with cyber and OSINT techniques in courses and case walkthroughs, so learners can pivot from off-chain signals to blockchain activity.

  • Partner with sales, value engineering, and customer success to scope training engagements, support onboarding and enablement, and turn training into adoption and expansion.

  • Build relationships with law enforcement and industry partners across the region to grow the TRM Academy cadre and learner community.

  • Develop train-the-trainer materials and instructor guides so the Academy can scale in EMEA and coach other instructors as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5+ years of experience instructing courses, leading trainings, or delivering technical instruction.

  • Blockchain, cryptocurrency, or digital assets subject matter expertise (core requirement), ideally from hands-on on-chain investigations or crypto-enabled crime casework.

  • Law enforcement or government experience, or a proven track record training these audiences. Police and financial crime investigators are especially welcome.

  • Eligibility to obtain a government security clearance in the UK or another EMEA country.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Experience building coursework, curriculum, labs, and appropriate testing.

  • Comfortable training private-sector audiences, such as crypto businesses/VASPs, exchanges, and financial institutions.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to command the room.

  • Willingness and ability to travel 50-75% across EMEA.

  • AI fluency (part of our performance review process and of the interview process).

Nice to Have

  • Professional fluency in German (strongly preferred, given the size of our DACH opportunity).

  • Fluency in French, or in a Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European language.

  • An existing national security clearance.

  • Experience in or alongside a national security, intelligence, or financial intelligence unit.

  • Working knowledge of cyber investigations, OSINT, and/or cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tradecraft.

  • Relevant certifications (for example GIAC credentials such as GCTI or GOSI, or similar cyber and OSINT credentials).

  • A Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European background in crypto, particularly with national security experience.

A Note on AI Fluency

TRM is an AI-native company. We expect our instructors to already be using AI tools in their day-to-day work to accelerate research, author and refine training content, and speed up investigative and analytical workflows. AI fluency is not awareness or interest; it is production usage. It is evaluated in our interview process and is part of our performance review process.

Why This Role Matters

Investigators and analysts across Europe are facing crypto-enabled crime at growing scale, from fraud and ransomware to sanctions evasion and terrorism finance. By teaching them to trace funds on TRM's platforms and combine that with cyber and OSINT tradecraft, you directly increase how quickly and confidently they can detect, investigate, and disrupt the threats that put people at risk. Every cohort you train turns abstract concepts into concrete skills they can apply to active cases that week, and you will help define how TRM Academy shows up across EMEA.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
fullText:
<div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.</p> <p>In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.</p> <p>Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.</p> <p><strong>Day-to-day in this role you'll:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the revenue tracking infrastructure:</strong> own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place</li> <li><strong>Run the commercial operating cadence,</strong> including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership</li> <li><strong>Own sales planning across markets:</strong> set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals</li> <li><strong>Turn sales performance data into action</strong> by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on</li> <li><strong>Design and roll out incentive systems,</strong> including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue</li> <li><strong>Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion,</strong> so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side</li> <li><strong>Automate and scale with AI,</strong> removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role,</strong> ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.</li> <li><strong>A track record in sales planning:</strong> quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with data and systems.</strong> You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing incentive models,</strong> variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>A builder and generalist</strong> who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders,</strong> able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.</li> <li><strong>Strong understanding of distinct sales motions,</strong> including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <p>You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Make a visible impact every day,</strong> directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.</li> <li><strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment,</strong> with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Build a career, not just a role,</strong> as DashOS grows across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deliver together</strong> in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div>

title: Product Analytics Team Lead
fullText:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

  • Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

  • Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

  • Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

  • Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

  • Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

  • A strong statistics background

  • Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

  • Data catalogues like DataHub

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

  • Warehouse: Snowflake

  • Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

  • Experimentation: GrowthBook

  • Self-service analytics: Omni

  • ML workflows: Prefect

  • GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)
