title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
fullText:
About the Role

Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live.

We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform.

You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns.

  • Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

  • Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements

  • At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

  • Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS.

  • Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them.

  • Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark

  • Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis)

  • Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory)

  • Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation)

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
fullText:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team.

The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem.

Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost.

  • Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up.

  • Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building.

  • Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback.

  • Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality.

  • Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down.

  • Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next.

Inspire us by

  • Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus.

  • Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them.

  • Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus.

  • End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality.

  • Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders.

  • Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving.

  • Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus.

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

  • Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany

  • Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort

  • Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best

Innovation through diversity

Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

Still here?

Then we might be the perfect match!

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
fullText:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Team's mission

Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.

Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.

Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes.

Your mission

You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money.

In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed.

What you’ll do:

  • Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services.

  • Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space.

  • Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together.

  • Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant.

  • Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention.

  • Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping.

What you bring:

  • A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table.

  • Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up).

  • Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client.

  • Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.

  • A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing.

  • True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.

  • A working understanding of event-driven architectures.

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints.

  • Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets .

  • The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.

  • Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.

  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.

  • Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

title: C2 Software Engineer
fullText:
Walaris designs and develops AI-driven, software-defined, and hardware-enabled autonomous systems for defense and security applications. Our software platform uses artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and edge computing to provide real-time situational awareness for air, land, and sea domains, enabling rapid decisions at machine speed. Our cutting-edge technology is utilized by customers across the defense, national security, government, marine, and critical infrastructure protection markets worldwide.

Software engineers at Walaris are at the core of our company, tackling complex and mission-critical technical challenges with the latest technologies. They integrate real-time machine learning and image processing systems and are constantly designing innovative software solutions to provide best in class capabilities. Working in cross-functional, international teams, our engineers consistently strive to exceed customer expectations.

For our office in Nuremberg, we are looking for a C2 Software Engineer (m/f/d) starting in April 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Develop command-and-control (C2) systems to meet operational and technical requirements derived from strategic company objectives
  • Integrate Walaris software and technology into military and security systems to add autonomous capabilities and boost overall system performance
  • Develop software solutions that improve system reliability, deployment velocity, and developer experience
  • Own and deliver complex features end-to-end across the full stack, from web-based frontend interfaces through distributed backend services and technical design through production deployment iteration
  • Ensure compliance with relevant military safety and quality standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that requirements from R&D, sales, and product management are fully integrated and effectively addressed throughout the development process

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in the development of complex software systems with strong proficiency in Rust, C++, or Python
  • Experience with distributed systems and system integration
  • Hands-on experience with multithreading and concurrency, asynchronous and distributed systems, containerized architectures (e.g., Docker-based environments), messaging systems (e.g., ZeroMQ, DDS, NATS, or similar), and performance optimization and system tuning
  • Expertise in software development on Linux platforms
  • Solid understanding of networking protocols and communication mechanisms, including TCP/IP, UDP, and inter-process communication (IPC)
  • Experience designing and working with REST APIs
  • Knowledge of low-latency communication systems
  • Fluent in English and German

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-availability and fault-tolerant systems
  • Understanding of real-time and deterministic system requirements
  • Experience with sensor integration and multi-modal sensor fusion in event-driven systems
  • Background in geospatial data systems (GIS/geoinformatics) or processing of time-series data
  • Experience building software according to DALs and standards like DO-278, DO-178, or ASIL
  • Familiarity with NATO standards like SAPIENT, STANAG 4586, etc.

Benefits

Join our mission and become part of an innovative, dynamic team! At Walaris, you’ll play a vital role in saving lives and safeguarding local and national security by harnessing the power of cutting-edge technologies. This is your chance to break new ground and take on meaningful responsibility as you help develop and deploy industry-defining solutions.

We offer creative freedom, competitive compensation, and a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions truly matter.

If you’re ready to make an impact, we invite you to apply by submitting your cover letter, resume, and transcript through our online application form.

title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
fullText:
<h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. fullText:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Contexte

Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?

Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.

Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing.

Volet recherche (environ 3 mois)

• Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes.

• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.

• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.

• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.

Volet produit (environ 3 mois)

• Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier).

• Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour.

• Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit.

Livrables attendus

• Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture.

• Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation.

• Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution.

Profil

• Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités.

• Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états.

• Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires.

• Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :

title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
fullText:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

Context & Motivation
A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for:
  • Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service
  • Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert
  • Higher availability and durability of customer data
    • This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps.

    More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad

    Your Mission
    As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 
     
    1. State of the Art
    Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 
     
    2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models
    Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline:
  • Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models)
  • Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it
  • Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) 
  • Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance
    •  
    3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research
    Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale:
  • Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods
  • Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel
  • Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results
  • Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes
    •  
    4. Evaluation & Validation
    Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to:
  • Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation)
    Quantify performance per failure family and scenario
  • Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring

    • Expected Outcomes & Valorization
    Depending on results, the work may be valorized through:
     
  • A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers
  • New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark
  • Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team

    • Technical Stack
  • Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis)
  • PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models)
  • SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation
  • LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling

    • Candidate Profile
  • Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science
  • Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus
  • Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research
  • Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
  • Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them
  • Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English
  • Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite

    • Work Environment
    You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from:
     
  • Mentorship from R&D engineers
  • Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection
  • Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies
  • A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions

    • Why Join Scality?
  • Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact
  • Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research
  • Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants
  • Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies
  • Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship

La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p>

title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
fullText:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
fullText:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with hydraulic machinery

  • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning

  • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

  • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

  • Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

  • Experience with data curation for ML applications

  • Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. 

  • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. 

    • This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

  • You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. 

  • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

  • You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. 

  • You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage.

  • You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism.

title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
fullText:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
fullText:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Backend Platform team:

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python.

  • Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system.

  • Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

  • Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each.

  • Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact.

  • Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation.

  • Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team.

  • Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

  • Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both.

  • Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance.

  • Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind.

  • Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs).

  • Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes.

  • Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production.

  • A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking.

  • Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them.

title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
fullText:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

title: Senior Data Engineer
fullText:
WHAT WE DO

Founded in 2007, Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) is a consulting and technology services company. We consult, design, build and modernize revenue-generating software and data engineering solutions for clients. With modernization services and AI tools, we help businesses achieve a competitive advantage through technology. GAP is a woman-owned company headquartered in Austin Texas. We are a values-based company focused on growing our people by investing in education, onsite English classes and training in the latest technologies, including AI, data analytics and machine learning. Our goal is to provide solutions for our customers that help them achieve critical business outcomes, while enabling our GAPSters and our communities to attain long-term success.

Summary
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and operate the data pipelines that consolidate portfolio company data into a single, business-aligned model on Databricks for a company in the private equity and asset management industry. You will own pipelines end to end, from incremental ingestion through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers to serving data for BI reporting and internal applications. This role also supports a key migration from a legacy system, including historical loads and financial reconciliation before cutover. You will work with a high level of autonomy and partner closely with finance, reporting and application teams.

Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience building production data pipelines, including 2+ years on Databricks with Delta Lake

  • Hands-on experience implementing medallion architectures (Bronze, Silver, Gold) with incremental processing

  • Proven track record in data quality and reconciliation, including tracing incorrect figures back to their source

  • Experience supporting data migrations from legacy SQL Server environments to modern lakehouse platforms

    Key Responsibilities

  • Build incremental ingestion pipelines using watermarks and change timestamps, safely handling late-arriving data and retaining full raw history

  • Model and transform data across Silver and Gold layers, including deduplication, unit and currency conversion, and quarantine of suspect records

  • Implement dimensional models with fact tables, slowly changing dimensions and reference data optimized for Power BI and application use

  • Support the migration from the legacy system, loading and freezing historical data and reconciling figures before cutover

  • Publish curated data to downstream consumers through Delta tables and Postgres-based synced tables for applications

  • Orchestrate, monitor and document pipelines, manage access and lineage in Unity Catalog, and maintain runbooks

    Required Technical Skills
    Strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Lakehouse: Databricks, Delta Lake, MERGE, change data feed, medallion architecture

  • Languages: SQL (Spark SQL and T-SQL), Python, PySpark

  • Data Modeling: dimensional modeling, fact grain definition, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions

  • Governance & Quality: Unity Catalog or a similar governance layer, data quality checks, reconciliation, lineage

  • Performance: BI workload tuning, file layout, clustering, query plan analysis

    Nice to Have

  • Experience with private equity, asset management or fund administration data, such as portfolio monitoring, valuations and cash flows

  • Knowledge of financial reporting concepts such as LTM and YTD periods, fiscal year ends, restatements and FX conversion

  • Experience with Lakeflow (Delta Live Tables), Databricks Workflows, or Databricks Lakebase and PostgreSQL

  • CI/CD and infrastructure as code for data pipelines, such as Databricks Asset Bundles, on Microsoft Azure

    Soft Skills

  • Advanced English proficiency

  • Clear written communication, able to explain data issues and trade-offs to non-technical users

  • Strong attention to detail and ownership of data accuracy

  • Collaborative mindset when working with vendors, finance and reporting teams

VisiQuate helps healthcare organizations capture the full value of the care they deliver. Through AI-driven process mining and automation, advanced analytics, purpose-built agents, and intelligent workflows, VisiQuate turns complex revenue cycle data into actionable intelligence. Backed by more than 15 years of award-winning revenue cycle expertise, VisiQuate helps teams identify recoverable revenue, uncover the root causes of denials and payment delays, and prioritize the work that matters most.

2027 is an exciting year that provides exponential opportunity for VisiQuate, our clients, and our marketing organization. Following the VisiQuate and Artiva HCx acquisition announcement, we are building a modern marketing team to support growth.

Summary:

The Director, Marketing Operations is marketing's functional operations leader, owning the systems, data and processes that show what marketing contributes. You will stand up a new HubSpot marketing automation platform connected to Salesforce, bring transparency to the funnel from MQL to bookings as defined by the CMO, with ongoing feedback to Sales, Finance and other cross-functional leaders, and give leadership a monthly view of marketing-sourced pipeline they can trust. Through your team, you also own project management and digital marketing, including the website. Partnership with Revenue Operations to co-own, maintain and develop marketing's AI agents, using them to make the team more efficient.

This is a build from zero, at the moment the function, the brand and the portfolio are all being rebuilt. You set the standards from day one, working in lockstep with executive marketing leadership. Reports to the CMO and leads the Digital Marketing & Operations Manager; measured on funnel conversion against target and speed to lead.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the HubSpot Marketing Hub implementation and its Salesforce integration.
  • Make the funnel stages and conversion targets the CMO sets (MQL, SAL, SQL, marketing-sourced bookings) transparent, and give RevOps, Finance and Sales leaders ongoing feedback against them.
  • Build lead scoring, lifecycle stages and routing, and run the service level for speed to lead and follow-up.
  • Load and route campaign and organic leads in Salesforce and HubSpot so Events and Sales can follow up fast.
  • Own attribution and reporting: a monthly funnel report against targets and dashboards for leadership and the board.
  • Design campaign architecture, automation and nurture programs with Integrated Marketing.
  • Own marketing data: quality, list management, email compliance. Work with RevOps, which owns the data and intent sources (Definitive Healthcare, ZoomInfo), to use those tools for marketing target lists and scoring.
  • Govern the Webflow website platform and its integrations; supporting your direct report, the Digital Marketing & Operations Manager, in building pages.
  • Own the plan, budget and timeline for the 2027 website optimization and likely rebuild, with SEO and AEO/GEO built in, Brand & Creative on design and the Digital Marketing & Operations Manager leading the technical build.
  • Write the SOPs and standards for campaigns, naming and intake, and own the martech stack and its budget.
  • Own marketing project management: the intake process, individual project briefs, timelines and the marketing calendar, with the Digital Marketing & Operations Manager running day-to-day intake.
  • Own marketing's AI agents for marketing efficiency, in close partnership with RevOps, and find new places automation can help.
  • Manage the digital agency through June 2027, then own the paid digital program and budget, with Integrated Marketing setting campaign goals. Lead and develop the Digital Marketing & Operations Manager, who runs the channels.
