At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN One is seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer with substantial hands-on software development experience and deep expertise in application security. This is an engineering role, not a scanner administration position: you will read and write production code, partner directly with developers, perform nuanced manual code reviews, and embed secure design, testing and release controls into modern DevSecOps pipelines. Your work will protect internal STN products and customer-facing software, including APIs, web services, cloud workloads and endpoint/agent integrations.

Key Responsibilities

Application Security & Secure Code Review
  • Perform manual security reviews of application source code and pull requests; trace authentication, authorization, business logic, input validation, serialization, cryptography and sensitive-data flows to identify exploitable defects.
  • Write and review production-quality code and security fixes in collaboration with engineering teams; build regression tests that demonstrate vulnerabilities are resolved rather than merely suppressed.
  • Integrate and tune SAST, software composition analysis (SCA), secret scanning, infrastructure-as-code scanning, container image checks and DAST into CI/CD pipelines with actionable findings.
Security Architecture & Risk Assessment
  • Own threat modeling, secure design reviews and architecture guidance for web, API, cloud, distributed-service, Windows/macOS/Linux agent and browser-extension components as assigned.
  • Assess software supply-chain risk including third-party dependencies, SBOM generation, build provenance, artifact signing and CI/CD identity/token permissions.
  • Help developers secure REST/GraphQL APIs, identity and session flows, service-to-service authentication, secrets management and tenant isolation.
  • Prioritize findings using exploitability and business impact; establish clear remediation SLAs, waiver/exception processes and measurable risk-reduction reporting.
Secure Development Practices & Emerging Technologies
  • Design lightweight secure coding standards, developer education, code-review checklists and reusable secure libraries or templates.
  • Review AI-assisted coding practices and application integrations with LLMs, agents and MCP where applicable, focusing on prompt injection, tool permissions, data exposure and trust boundaries.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  • Collaborate with engineering, SRE/DevOps, SOC, red team, privacy and customer security stakeholders to validate vulnerabilities and improve defense-in-depth.
  • Drive measurable adoption of secure SDLC practices while maintaining developer velocity, reliable builds and auditable security evidence.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering and application security combined, including meaningful responsibility for production application code and developer collaboration.
  • Strong development proficiency in at least two mainstream languages (for example Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Java or Go) plus practical knowledge of secure architecture and debugging.
  • Proven ability to find and fix application vulnerabilities through manual source review, threat modeling and exploit-aware testing (OWASP ASVS/Top 10, CWE).
  • Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD security controls and analyzing results from SAST, DAST, SCA, secret and supply-chain tooling; solid API, cloud and container fundamentals.
  • Active CSSLP, GIAC GWEB/GWAPT, or OffSec OSWE certification (at least one required); equivalent certifications may be reviewed by hiring leadership.
Preferred
  • Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, endpoint/security agents, browser extensions and hybrid AWS/Azure platforms; GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of NIST SSDF, secure build attestations, artifact signing, SBOM workflows, IaC/Kubernetes security and developer enablement programs.
  • Experience supporting developer review workflows for sensitive data handling, privacy-by-design and software vulnerability disclosure programs.
  • Experience creating reusable security test cases and partnering with product teams to remediate business-logic and authorization flaws.

Compensation

title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, UK)
fullText:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £107,077 - £128,493. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

#LI-Remote

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

title: Senior Staff SRE, Architecture Engineering: Hosted Runners
fullText:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

When a customer pushes a change, they need their CI/CD jobs to start quickly and run reliably, even when demand spikes. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.

As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes
  • Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads
  • Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing

What You'll Do

  • Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.
  • Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.
  • Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.
  • Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.
  • Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.
  • Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.
  • Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.

What You'll Bring

  • Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.
  • Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.
  • Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.
  • A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.
  • A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. You build agreement through clear writing and asynchronous collaboration, and mentor engineers to own what they build and operate.

About the team

Hosted Runners operates the compute behind customers' CI/CD jobs. You'll work with Runner Core to turn lessons from operating the fleet into improvements to the open-source GitLab Runner. You'll also work with Product and partner teams to agree on priorities and ownership for shared changes.

Learn more:

title: Product Engineering Lead - Andera
fullText:
About Andera

Andera is building reliable AI agents for back-office financial work, starting with automating audits for the world’s largest public companies.

Audits have resisted automation for decades due to the scale and instability of the underlying data. Large companies generate hundreds of millions of tokens of financial data across massive spreadsheets with constantly changing formats. Even understanding a single document can take expert auditors six or more hours, and a typical audit involves many of them.

We’re building agents that can parse, interpret, and reason over data of this complexity—compressing gigabytes of messy financial information into representations that LLMs can work with reliably. The result is turning weeks of manual audit work into minutes of review.

This work requires long-horizon reasoning, robust data systems, and production-grade reliability—and it forms the foundation for automating some of the most complex financial workflows in the world.

Founding Team

Andera is built on the belief that this problem can only be solved by pairing elite auditors with elite engineers.

  • Engineering team: Alumni of MIT, Berkeley, and Waterloo, with experience at Jane Street, Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft.

  • Audit team: Former #1 performers at Deloitte and leaders of national finance practices at Revolut.

The Role

We’re hiring a Product Engineering Lead to own the primary product experience used by professional auditors. You’ll be responsible for designing and building interfaces that surface large, complex financial datasets and make AI agent output understandable, auditable, and trustworthy.

This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on adoption, trust, and product quality.

What You’ll Work On

  • Designing and building intuitive workflows for reviewing complex financial data and AI agent output

  • Designing and translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready applications

  • Building a new platform from the ground up, and designing end-to-end features that span frontend, backend, and infrastructure

  • Working directly with auditors (in house and customers) to understand their workflows and pain points

  • Improving reliability, performance, and observability across the product

  • Collaborating closely with AI and systems engineers to integrate agent capabilities into the UI

  • Building the product team from the ground up

What We’re Looking For

Strong fullstack engineering skills with ownership mindset

  • You can design and ship features end to end

  • You understand how UI, backend, and data systems interact

Deep empathy for users in complex domains

  • You can work with auditors to uncover root problems

  • You can translate ambiguous feedback into clear product decisions

Strong product and design sense

  • You know what makes an interface intuitive and trustworthy

  • You can turn wireframes into clean, usable experiences

Comfort operating in high-complexity systems

  • Large datasets, asynchronous workflows, partial failures

Experience with or adjacent to our stack:

  • TypeScript, Python, Temporal, Docker, Terraform, AWS Fargate

Why Andera

  • Own the core product experience from day one

  • Build software used by some of the largest companies in the world

Work closely with world-class auditors and engineers
High ownership and impact as an early team member

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $129,000 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $149,500 to $177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Enhance, extend, and operate our existing batch and streaming pipelines and Delta Lake tables on Databricks, evolving the platform across ingestion, orchestration, storage, and serving as data volume and business needs grow.
  • Partner with business analysts, ad strategists, and the sales team to understand their questions and turn them into durable data and insights products, such as campaign performance, audience, and revenue reporting.
  • Build and maintain dbt models and tests for curated Silver/Gold datasets, and own the semantic layer and core business metrics so every team works from a single, trusted definition of performance.
  • Manage Databricks and AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Integrate and reconcile data from ad platforms, CRM, partner feeds, and internal systems, including migrations off legacy tools and reports.
  • Implement data quality tests, monitoring, lineage, SLAs, and alerting, and define data contracts with upstream producers, leading root-cause analysis when data breaks.
  • Tune Spark and Databricks workloads for performance and cost (query plans, partitioning, shuffle and skew, cluster sizing), and make cost-aware design decisions as the platform grows.
  • Establish engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, testing, documentation), and mentor engineers and help shape the team’s technical roadmap.
  • Apply data governance, privacy, and access controls (PII, GDPR, CCPA, SOX) across the platform.
  • Enhance our LLM development support capabilities by creating tools, skills, and agents that give our LLMs more context and help us debug, build, and maintain systems faster.

Success in Year One

Within the first year, the person hired will be the go-to engineer for our foundational data models and pipelines. Pipeline runtime and compute spend will be measurably lower, and the datasets and metrics that analysts, ad strategists, and sales use will have clear owners and documented definitions. Stakeholders will answer more of their own questions without waiting on the data team, and the first set of enhancements they asked for will be in production.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering building production data platforms at enterprise scale, with demonstrated ownership of data products and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala), including partitioning and shuffle behavior, joins, skew handling, caching, and diagnosing and tuning slow or costly jobs.
  • Deep knowledge of the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, Structured Streaming, and SQL Warehouses, with proven experience optimizing workloads for performance and cost (cluster and warehouse sizing, autoscaling, Photon, serverless).
  • Strong SQL and Python (or Scala) skills for pipeline development, automation, and query optimization.
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt, including model design, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies, running on Databricks in CI/CD-driven workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud and data platform infrastructure as code, and with AWS (S3, IAM, and networking fundamentals as they relate to data platforms).
  • Strong experience with orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or similar), Git, and CI/CD, and with building reliable, observable pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star schemas, medallion architecture) and experience building semantic layers or metric definitions.
  • Experience inheriting, refactoring, and improving existing data models and pipelines, with an eye toward reliability, maintainability, and backward compatibility for downstream consumers.
  • Experience using AI/LLM coding assistants (for example, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code), with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and owning generated code rather than accepting it at face value.
  • Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from analysts, ad strategists, and sales teams into well-designed data products and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with data governance and compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and with BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Prior experience with advertising, ad tech, or media data (campaign delivery, attribution, audience, or revenue reporting) is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

AI-Native Expectations

The Ads Data Engineering team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, while owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment.

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice:

  • Daily use — You use AI coding assistants for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

title: Principal Agentic Engineer, AI Ecosystem
fullText:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360's AI ecosystem is being built by three teams working from a shared 2027 vision, each owning a distinct layer:

  • AI Platforms — the foundational infrastructure and company-wide AI governance: gateways and MCP connector infra, cost and spend controls, observability and safety guardrails, the agent deployment/orchestration platform, and knowledge graphs.
  • AI Dev Tooling (AI DevX) — AI-powered developer tools that remove friction across the software development lifecycle: coding assistance and productivity tooling, automated and agentic testing, and the codified primitives (CLAUDE.md, evals) that make shared and monolithic repos legible to AI.
  • Agentic PDLC — agents that remove humans from common, repetitive product-development work: on-call investigation, bug triage, code review, and release, consolidated under a single owner instead of being built ad hoc team-by-team.

These teams deliberately don't own everything. A set of foundational questions — non-human identity and agent authZ, model regression eval frameworks, workflow/agent eval infrastructure, atomic agent-unit definitions, agent standards for what an agent can never do — sit in the shared space between them, ready to be addressed.

About the Job

We're hiring a Principal-level Agentic Engineer to hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC — and to give the unowned middle ground between them an owner. This is not a coordination role. You'll have clear, end-to-end ownership of a defined set of cross-cutting problems, not an open-ended advisory brief. It's an architecture-and-build role for someone who can define what an "agent" is as a reusable unit at Life360, set the standards that make agents safe and evaluable, build an ecosystem that supports our agents, and then help each team build to that architecture. In addition, this role will craft the vision for how our broad agent ecosystem will evolve into the future.

The role operates at two altitudes, and needs to be genuinely strong at both:

  • Strategic: set the technical vision for Life360's AI-Native developer ecosystem — the architecture that lets AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC build against shared primitives instead of re-solving the same problems three times.
  • Tactical: get into the core components yourself — agent execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, eval harnesses, identity and authZ for unattended agents — and ship the parts that are too foundational to leave to any one team, or that no team currently owns.

You'll partner closely with the AI Platforms, AI Dev Tooling, Agentic PDLC, and our Product leadership (as their technical counterpart), but you won't report through any single one of them — your mandate is the seams between all of them.

The US-based salary range for this position is $247,000 to $363,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Architect across the ecosystem

  • Hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC, so investments compose instead of collide.
  • Drive build-vs-buy decisions for PDLC-critical agents, and for ecosystem-wide capabilities where an outside vendor may out-deliver an internal build.
  • Build the ecosystem that supports agents as we define them today and shapes how they evolve: execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, and telemetry that treat token spend as a first-class design constraint.

Define & own the unowned middle

  • Define what an agent is at Life360 — a reusable unit, the interface it exposes, and the standards it must meet (human-in-the-loop and blast-radius policy, eval standards, promotion gates) — in partnership with AI Platforms, who will operate the resulting infrastructure long-term.
  • Design the non-human identity and agent authZ model that unblocks scheduled and unattended agents across every team.
  • Stand up eval and regression infrastructure (framework, CI hooks, result storage) as a shared capability rather than three parallel bets.

Build, hands-on

  • Avoid “ivory tower” syndrome by shipping production code against the highest-leverage components yourself — you're a builder first, not an advisor who hands off specs.
  • Get close to live bets, such as the on-call investigation agent, to validate the architecture under real usage and economics, and prototype and de-risk the hardest pieces before asking any team to commit engineering time.

Lead without owning the org chart

  • Mentor Agentic Engineers and Staff engineers across all three teams on agent architecture, context engineering, and evaluation rigor, and help grow the senior technical bench.
  • Write the architecture decision records, standards docs, and playbooks that AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC can each build against independently, and represent a coherent technical point of view in build-vs-buy and roadmap discussions, even without formal authority over the teams involved.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of engineering experience, including deep platform or systems architecture work at consumer scale (50M+ MAU or equivalent preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience architecting agentic systems in production — not just using AI coding tools, but designing the frameworks, identity models, and eval infrastructure that other agents run on.
  • Direct experience with non-human identity, service-account, or agent authZ models — or a clear, well-reasoned point of view on how to build one.
  • Experience designing and consuming structured interfaces for AI systems (MCP-style tool definitions, JSON Schema, OpenAPI) and building for tool-calling and contract-first agent development.
  • A track record of building eval and regression frameworks for AI systems — promotion gates, scoring, and CI integration — not just running evals ad hoc.
  • Strong architectural instincts across multiple services and teams, with the judgment to know which problems deserve a shared platform investment and which don't.
  • Fluency in AI economics — token cost as a design constraint, progressive retrieval, and the tradeoffs between centralizing and forking model usage.
  • A track record of driving technical direction across teams you don't manage — through documentation, prototypes, and demonstrated results rather than mandates.
  • Excellent written communication: architecture decision records, standards, and playbooks precise enough for other engineers (and their agents) to build against directly.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating an agent orchestration or deployment platform, or an MCP-style connector gateway.
  • Background in ML infrastructure, model observability, or production AI systems at a company that has been through a comparable AI-native transformation.
  • Experience with mobile engineering (iOS/Android) or high-throughput cloud systems, and how agent architecture needs to flex across both.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

Our Commitment to Belonging

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced, commercially minded Commercial Counsel to join our global Legal team and support our next phase of growth.

Operating in a fast paced, agile environment, we need a legal partner who brings sound judgement, moves at pace, and turns complex legal issues into practical solutions that help the business close deals and scale.

With primary responsibility for commercial contracting, you will work closely with Sales and other business teams to structure, negotiate, and execute agreements with customers and partners worldwide. You will own negotiations from initial review through to signature, balancing appropriate legal protections with commercial priorities and building trusted relationships across the business.

Alongside your core contracting responsibilities, you will support broader legal and compliance matters and help build an efficient, technology-enabled legal function.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Contracts & Deal Execution

  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of complex B2B commercial agreements, including:
    • SaaS subscriptions and software licensing agreements.
    • Professional services, implementation, and consultancy agreements.
    • Reseller, channel partner, and strategic alliance agreements.
    • Supplier, vendor, and technology procurement agreements.
    • Confidentiality, data processing, and information security agreements.
  • Act as the primary legal partner for commercial teams, taking ownership of negotiations and keeping deals moving through to execution.
  • Provide clear, commercially sound advice on deal structures, contractual commitments, risk allocation, and negotiation strategy.
  • Navigate enterprise customer procurement processes and customer contract terms, finding workable solutions to negotiation barriers.
  • Partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Security, and Services to ensure contractual commitments are commercially viable and operationally deliverable.
  • Manage competing priorities across a busy deal pipeline, escalating material risks with clear recommendations and proposed solutions.

AI, Technology & Innovation

  • Advise on contractual considerations relating to AI-enabled products and services, including data use, intellectual property, confidentiality, and allocation of responsibility.
  • Work with Product, Engineering, and Security to understand evolving capabilities and translate them into clear, appropriate contractual terms.
  • Use approved AI tools and legal technology to improve contract review, drafting, knowledge management, and workflow efficiency, applying appropriate confidentiality controls and legal judgement.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring legal work while maintaining quality and consistency.

General Legal & Compliance Support

  • Provide pragmatic, business-focused legal advice across a global technology organisation.
  • Support data protection, anti-bribery, export control, sanctions, and other relevant compliance activities, coordinating specialist advice where needed.
  • Advise on intellectual property protection and licensing matters.
  • Support corporate governance, subsidiary management, and the development of internal policies.
  • Assist People & Culture with employment agreements and related matters as required.
  • Manage commercial disputes and pre-litigation issues, engaging external counsel proportionately and effectively.

Legal Operations & Business Enablement

  • Develop and maintain contract templates, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, and guidance that enable faster, more consistent contracting.
  • Improve contract intake, prioritisation, approval, and lifecycle management processes.
  • Deliver practical training that helps commercial teams identify key issues, understand approval requirements, and progress routine matters confidently.
  • Use stakeholder feedback and contracting data to identify bottlenecks and improve turnaround times.
  • Help scale a responsive legal function that supports Energy Exemplar’s global expansion.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualified lawyer admitted to practise in at least one jurisdiction.
  • Typically, 5–8 years’ post-qualification experience, with substantial experience drafting and negotiating B2B SaaS and software agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex enterprise negotiations and deliver timely, commercially workable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of intellectual property, data privacy, and technology contracting, with experience of AI-related contractual issues desirable.
  • Experience supporting international transactions and stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  • In-house experience within a fast-growing SaaS or technology business is highly desirable.

How You Work

  • Commercial judgement: You distinguish material risks from negotiable points and recommend practical paths forward.
  • Pace and ownership: You manage a varied workload, make sound decisions, and follow matters through to completion.
  • Agility: You adapt quickly as priorities, products, and business needs evolve.
  • Clear communication: You explain complex issues simply and negotiate confidently with customers, partners, and colleagues.
  • Collaboration: You build trust and work constructively across functions and time zones.
  • AI-first mindset: You actively explore how AI and technology can improve legal delivery, supported by careful review and accountability.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Ownership of high-impact commercial work in a growing global technology business.
  • The opportunity to help shape an AI-enabled legal function.
  • A collaborative, international team working at the intersection of energy, technology, and innovation.
  • Professional development and opportunities to broaden your responsibilities as the business grows.

title: Certified Recovery Coach: App Moderator
fullText:
A unique opportunity for Massachusetts recovery coaches to have a voice and make a difference!

Marigold Health is looking for an innovative peer/recovery coach to help people find their path to wellness and reduced substance use utilizing a new model for technology-enabled peer support. The opportunity may be for full or part-time depending on our needs and your experience. Our app operates 24/7 with shifts ranging from 7 AM to 1 AM EST per day.

Marigold Health exists to give every person with a mental health or substance use condition a place to feel heard. Our work is focused on providing evidence-based, virtual peer support to people interested in recovery and/or in reducing harm from substance use.

We've designed a novel program that augments the work peers do with technology ranging from automated, interactive outreach to individuals to asynchronous, digital group discussions. Marigold's mobile app provides multiple avenues for people in recovery to build their recovery capital and expand their community networks.

We are looking for someone to join our team that has great communication skills and is excited to bring peer support/recovery coaching to a virtual platform. You will consistently drive member interaction, participation, and engagement within our app Groups and Forums, ensuring a valuable experience where members can learn from each other and get support in their recovery journeys.

What You'll Do

  • App Chat Moderation & Engagement
  • Stimulate meaningful conversations by initiating chat starters, particularly those related to recovery experiences. Share personal lived experience with mental health and/or addiction to support others seeking/maintaining recovery.
  • Use your experience to identify and engage a network of referring agencies as well as add to the database of member resources.
  • Oversee group chats and forum discussions to ensure a productive, on-topic environment that adheres to Marigold’s Code of Conduct (COC) guidelines by monitoring hate speech, spam, inappropriate language, or abusive content to maintain a safe space for all members.
  • Review flagged content based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) alerts, and take action as necessary, such as removing COC-violating content.
  • Engage in follow-up with members about next steps when a violation occurs and involve the appropriate peer support team member if needed.
  • Member Management
  • Actively welcome and engage new members as they join the app community, making them feel supported from day one.
  • Pause or remove members from groups when necessary, or work with the app administrators to address more serious issues.
  • Monitor crisis situations and ensure a Peer Support Specialist/ Recovery Coach follows up with members who require additional support.
  • Document your work in our record systems according to Marigold and prevailing standards.

What You Have

  • Completion of relevant training courses (certification ready) as a Peer Specialist or Recovery Coach in substance use disorder or mental health recovery in your state of residence. Recovery Coach in Massachusetts is strongly preferred.
  • Reliable access to internet in a private space (we provide equipment, e.g. laptop)
  • Comfort operating a smartphone, computer, and software tools such as Microsoft Office , Teams

title: Lead Energy Market Analyst - SPP & WECC
fullText:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Lead Energy Market Analyst – SPP & WECC will work directly with prospective and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical pre-sales work across the SPP and WECC footprints. Working side by side with Account Directors and Regional VP of Sales, the analyst identifies the customer use cases where PLEXOS, Aurora, and Adapt2 create measurable value, proves that value in demonstrations, proofs of concept and pilot studies built on the customer's own market, and helps shape the regional go-to-market strategy.

The analyst is the company's recognized subject matter expert on SPP and Western market design, resource adequacy, transmission planning and price formation. That expertise shows up three ways: in the room with customers, in published thought leadership that draws new prospects to Energy Exemplar, and in the feedback loop to Product that keeps the platforms ahead of market change.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with wide latitude. The analyst owns the technical narrative for SPP and WECC pursuits, mentors less experienced analysts on the team, and is accountable, with Sales, for pipeline progression and technical win rate in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain energy market models with a focus on the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) and Western Electricity Coordinating Council (WECC) regions, leveraging PLEXOS to analyze market dynamics, transmission constraints, generation dispatch, and regulatory developments while providing technical expertise and modeling solutions to prospective and existing customers.
  • Translate customer business problems (resource adequacy filings, IRPs, RFP evaluation, interconnection economics, trading strategy, transmission justification) into modeling workflows and a clear commercial value story.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations, workshops, executive briefings and proofs of concept built in the customer's own market, converting them into new-logo and expansion opportunities.
  • Own the technical content of proposals, RFP and RFI responses and statements of work for the region, coordinating input from Product, Services and Legal.
  • Deepen existing accounts by identifying adjacent use cases, new user groups and cross-sell paths (PLEXOS to Aurora, planning to trading, simulation to AI Studio).
  • Build, configure and validate PLEXOS and Aurora models for SPP and WECC: nodal and zonal topologies, generation and storage fleets, fuel and hydro assumptions, load and large-load forecasts, and market rules.
  • Execute production cost, capacity expansion, resource adequacy and ELCC, LMP and congestion, storage valuation, transmission benefit and interconnection studies, and present results with commercial takeaways.
  • Maintain the team's regional reference models and input libraries, benchmarked against published ISO, WECC and utility results, with documented workflows that Services can inherit.
  • Showcase PLEXOS Intelligence capabilities (scenario automation, backtesting and calibration, results interpretation) on regional use cases.
  • Identify and prioritize SPP and WECC use cases by segment, size the opportunity, and co-develop the regional go-to-market plan, target accounts, messaging and competitive positioning with Sales and Marketing.
  • Create reusable demonstration assets, playbooks and enablement content so the wider Americas team can sell confidently into SPP and WECC.
  • Serve as Energy Exemplar's public voice on SPP and Western market topics through white papers, webinars and presentations at SPP, WECC, CAISO, WPTF, NWPPA, WSPP and industry conferences.
  • Monitor FERC orders, SPP and CAISO market design changes, WRAP and Markets+ milestones, state dockets and competitor activity, and brief Sales, Product and customers on the implications.
  • Channel structured customer requirements to Product, coordinate with post-sales Services on handoffs and renewal signals, and mentor Solutions analysts in market knowledge, modeling practice and customer-facing skills.

Candidate Requirements

  • 7+ years in wholesale electricity markets, power system planning, energy economics or energy consulting, with at least 3 years focused on SPP, the Western Interconnection or both.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production cost, capacity expansion or resource adequacy models in PLEXOS or Aurora, or in comparable tools with a demonstrated ability to learn new platforms quickly.
  • Working command of SPP and Western market design: day-ahead and real-time clearing, ancillary services, LMP and congestion, capacity accreditation, planning reserve margins, WRAP and state RA constructs, transmission planning processes and interconnection.
  • Proven customer-facing experience in pre-sales, consulting or client advisory, including scoping engagements, presenting to senior and executive audiences and managing competing stakeholder interests.
  • Ability to turn complex quantitative results into a crisp commercial story: what the number means, why it matters to the customer's decision and what to do next.
  • Strong data skills: Python or R, SQL and advanced Excel; comfort with large ISO, EIA, FERC and WECC datasets and with building repeatable data pipelines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; experience producing publication-quality reports, slides and webinar content.
  • Self-directed and organized; able to run several concurrent pursuits with Sales and deliver on committed timelines.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering, energy or environmental economics, applied mathematics, operations research, data science, public policy or a closely related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license, CFA or Energy Risk Professional (ERP) designation.
  • PLEXOS or Aurora certification, or completion of Energy Exemplar's advanced training programs.
  • Active membership in IEEE PES, IAEE, USAEE or similar professional bodies.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. title: Senior DevOps Engineer - LATAM
fullText:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to build the AI-native, self-service infrastructure platform that powers how Luxury Presence ships software. It's a platform where every developer, human or agent, can validate a change in minutes, understand failures immediately, and ship confidently.

You'll join a small, high-leverage Infrastructure team with a clear mandate: multiply what every engineer and agent can do through automation, self-service, and guardrails-by-design. The goal is a platform where self-service is the default and human intervention is the exception, and you'll help make that real.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the self-service infrastructure platform. Make the right thing the easy thing, and the secure thing the default.

  • Build the golden paths engineers and agents ship on. Within a technical direction set by the team's Staff engineers, build and operate the layers they rely on (a unified CI/CD pipeline, GitOps-based delivery with ArgoCD, an IaC module catalog, and scaffolding for new services), owning specific components end to end. The goal is for engineers and agents to provision infrastructure and ship changes within guardrails, without hand-writing Terraform/Kustomize or waiting on a ticket.

  • Make agents first-class developers. Help generalize our agent isolation pattern into reusable platform primitives: sandboxed runtime, workload identity, audit trails, and approval gates. Every agent action runs on the same identity, audit, ownership, cost-attribution, and approval rails as a human.

  • Build and operate the validation platform and quality gates. Provide the rails that teams validate changes on before production: ephemeral PR environments with auto-teardown, plus the security, performance, and load-testing gates developers rely on. Implement new gates as coverage grows, keep them fast and low-flake, and drive services onto them. Make gate and test results machine-readable and callable outside the PR flow, so agents and humans alike can act on a failure directly.

  • Own the reliability and observability of what you build. Create the dashboards and operational controls that make the surfaces you own observable and improvable as throughput grows: gate pass rates, approval-rate and self-service-ratio trends, common failure modes, cost attribution, and DORA metrics surfaced to teams. Carry on-call for those surfaces and run incidents from detection through follow-up, turning recurring toil into automation and runbooks other engineers reuse.

What We're Looking For

  • Senior-level experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering. You've built and operated production infrastructure at scale and can own a significant workstream end to end with limited oversight.

  • An active, opinionated use of AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) in your own infrastructure workflow: Terraform changes, Kubernetes debugging, automation, operational investigations. You have a point of view on where these tools help and where they don't.

  • Deep Kubernetes (EKS) and AWS experience (IAM, VPC, ECR, SSM/Secrets Manager, S3, SQS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora).

  • Strong IaC (Terraform) and GitOps experience, including PR-driven apply workflows (Atlantis or similar) and ArgoCD.

  • CI/CD depth (GitHub Actions), including caching/parallelism, artifact management, test reliability, and pipeline observability.

  • Full incident-ownership experience: you've carried on-call for systems you built and driven incidents from detection through follow-up.

  • Excellent cross-team communication: you can translate platform constraints into developer-friendly solutions and documentation.

Bonus Points

  • Identity, access, and policy-as-code experience: workload/service identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE, OIDC), short-lived credentials, secrets management (Vault), and policy enforcement.

  • Experience building self-service developer platforms, ephemeral environments, CLIs, scaffolding tools, or internal developer portals (Backstage or custom). You treat infrastructure as a product.

  • Cost-awareness: you've built cost attribution, budgets, or rightsizing into a platform.

Our Tech Stack

Infrastructure: AWS, EKS, Terraform (with Atlantis), Vault, Docker, OPA (Open Policy Agent).

CI/CD: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD + Kustomize (GitOps).

Messaging: Kafka (Confluent Cloud).

Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry.

Languages/Apps: Node.js/TypeScript microservices, Python, React front-ends.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Director of Product Marketing
fullText:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.

As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof:

  • Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona.
  • Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales.
  • Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners.
  • Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards.
  • Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging.
  • Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events.
  • Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end
  • Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions.
  • A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates.
  • Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts.

You’ll really stand out if you have:

  • Familiarity with digital identity standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, ISO mDL, NIST 800-63) or KYC/AML compliance.
  • Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise.
  • Experience with developer- or platform-led motions alongside enterprise sales.

Position logistics:

Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
  • Monthly work from home stipend
  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!

Compensation

This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity.

Additional Information

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.

Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Director, Agentic Engineering
